title: Tempest Pressure Drop Storm Watch
app: WeatherFlow Tempest, Ecowitt, PurpleAir, AirGradient, ESPHome plant sensors, aquarium controllers, and pollen feeds streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=weatherflow:obs
| sort 0 station _time
| streamstats current=f last(pressure_hpa) as prev_pressure_hpa by station
| eval pressure_drop_hpa=round(prev_pressure_hpa-pressure_hpa,1)
| where pressure_drop_hpa>4
| sort - pressure_drop_hpa
description: Uses Tempest barometric pressure telemetry to monitor rapid pressure drops that usually precede rough weather in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for storm setups before wind and rain arrive, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Tempest barometric pressure data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Event table of rapid pressure drops.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers rapid pressure drops that usually precede rough weather so you can spot storm setups before wind and rain arrive before it becomes annoying.
